sample_rule: At observed Base head select one newest previously mined Uniswap V3 Swap event per listed factory-verified pool inside fixed block range; link its precise event, successful transaction receipt and block header by hash, never an imagined source row or strategy fill. If none or unavailable, record status, not a zero fee.
native_fee_math: L2 transaction receipt fee = gasUsed*effectiveGasPrice in wei; L1 paid fee only if receipt explicitly returns l1Fee. Store separate native wei/ETH; no USD conversion without independently time-valid ETHUSDC price, and do not silently impute absent L1.
required_integrity: event and receipt transaction and block hashes exact
header hash and block number/time match; no future timestamps
all first-seen RPC response SHA256 and runtime timestamp
limits: public other-account historical transaction, not a $20 follower swap
tx gas is for entire unrelated transaction, may involve multiple pools
cannot infer own actual router gas, L1 data bytes, failed attempt rate, price impact, adverse selection or MEV
cannot count OOS returns or prospective paper days
MAX 8 read-only RPC calls, no retry/paid service/key/signing/broadcast
output: One report JSON with full raw source response hashes, chosen public transaction hashes, observed block timestamps, actual on-chain gas wei evidence if returned, and every unknown explicitly null; a compact CSV listing per-pool status/cost
